features: AI AT YOUR FINGERTIPS – Access AI-powered assistance instantly with the dedicated Copilot key. Boost productivity, simplify everyday tasks, and enjoy seamless support for work, creativity, and multitasking with just a single key press.

SEAMLESS MULTI-DEVICE CONNECTIVITY – Connect up to 3 Bluetooth-enabled devices and switch effortlessly between your laptop, tablet, smartphone, or PC. Compatible with Windows, macOS, ChromeOS, iOS, and iPadOS for ultimate versatility.

COMPACT & STYLISH MINIMALIST DESIGN – Featuring an ultra-slim 75% keyboard layout with premium pastel-inspired color options, the ASUS Marshmallow KW100 complements any workspace while remaining highly portable and clutter-free.

QUIET & COMFORTABLE TYPING EXPERIENCE – Designed with scissor-switch keys, 1.6 mm key travel, and a built-in silent foam layer for near-silent typing under 50 dB. Perfect for offices, libraries, meetings, and work-from-home environments.

ERGONOMIC AND PRODUCTIVITY-FOCUSED – Equipped with dual-level adjustable kickstands and dedicated system-switch keys for seamless transitions between operating systems. Includes convenient function hotkeys to enhance productivity across devices.

LONG-LASTING DURABILITY & BATTERY LIFE – Enjoy up to 24 months of battery life. Durable switches are rated for up to 10 million keystrokes and feature a UV-resistant coating for enhanced longevity and everyday reliability.
